notes: The Claude counterpart of the captured Copilot sessionStart payload - this provider's session-start class was never captured live, and the beacon needs one payload per vocabulary. The beacon hook answers with empty stdout and exit 0 and writes its liveness marker to MAISTER_BEACON_DIR, never under cwd: .maister/ is tracked in real consumer repositories, so a per-session file there would show up as an untracked file in every chain session. No state fixture: the beacon reads no run state.
